description: Manuel Gertrudix Barrio and colleagues publish a two-wave survey covering social acceptance of biorefineries in Spain’s Community of Madrid. The collection contains 1,000 valid online surveys from adults, gathered in October 2022 and November 2024, with a 23-item questionnaire in Spanish and English. CSV and SPSS data accompany methodology, variable documentation and statistical outputs. The March 2025 files are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Responses can inform public-acceptance assumptions or adoption behaviour in infrastructure-siting simulations. The summary does not establish whether respondents repeat across waves, the population weighting or response bias. Those uncertainties limit interpretation as individual attitude change. No related catalogue record explicitly includes this collection or its linked earlier publication. Files and respondent-level information were not downloaded.
